name: subscribe__min_interval_gates_initial_drain
description: Locks the Matter §10.6.5 MinIntervalFloor gate: after Subscribe stamps lastReport=admission-time (subscription.Manager.Subscribe), the engine MUST withhold dirty-path drains for at least MinIntervalFloor seconds. The scenario picks a deliberately long floor (3 s) and fires the engine immediately; expect_no_tx then asserts the bridge stays silent for the first 1500 ms after fire. Without the gate the engine would ship a report on every 250 ms tick, drowning Apple Home's MTRDevice in same-value bursts and triggering duplicate-suppression.
